title.zh: Tether And Fasanara Seed A $400 Million Private Credit Fund
title.en: Tether And Fasanara Seed A $400 Million Private Credit Fund

current_state.zh: Tether and Fasanara have seeded a $400 million evergreen private credit fund, with Fasanara managing investments and Tether originating USDT-linked deals and settlement, targeting up to $3 billion from outside institutions.
